name: Serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor
summary: Serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Most SNRIs function alongside primary metabolites and secondary metabolites in order to inhibit reuptake of serotonin, norepinepherine, and marginal amounts of dopamine. For example, venlafaxine works alongside its primary metabolite O-desmethylvenlafaxine to strongly inhibit serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake in the brain.

uses.text: Serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs) are a class of antidepressant medications used to treat major depressive disorder (MDD), anxiety disorders, chronic neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia, and menopausal symptoms. Off-label uses include treatments for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and obsessive–compulsive disorder (OCD).

sideEffects.text: Since SNRIs and SSRIs act in similar ways to elevate serotonin levels, they share many side effects, though to varying degrees. Some common side effects include nausea, dry mouth, dizziness, sweating, increased blood pressure, loss of appetite, headache, increase in suicidal thoughts, and sexual dysfunction. Elevation of norepinephrine levels can sometimes cause anxiety, mildly elevated pulse, and elevated blood pressure.

summaryZh: 5-羥色胺和去甲腎上腺素再攝取抑制劑，是一種用來治療重度憂鬱症和其他精神障礙的抗憂鬱藥。SNRI有時候也用來治療焦慮症，強迫症，多動症，慢性神經性疼痛，軀體化障礙，纖維肌痛症候群和緩解更年期症狀。
summaryZhHans: 5-羟色胺和去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂，是一种用来治疗重度抑郁症和其他精神障碍的抗抑郁药。SNRI有时候也用来治疗焦虑症，强迫症，多动症，慢性神经性疼痛，躯体化障碍，纤维肌痛综合征和缓解更年期症状。

fact.en: Venlafaxine, the first SNRI, reached the market in 1993. The idea came from the older tricyclic antidepressants, which block both transporters but also hit many other targets.
fact.zh: 第一個 SNRI 文拉法新於 1993 年上市。這個構想來自較舊的三環抗憂鬱藥，後者同樣阻斷兩種轉運蛋白，但也作用於許多其他標的。
fact.zhHans: 第一个 SNRI 文拉法新于 1993 年上市。这个构想来自较旧的三环抗忧郁药，后者同样阻断两种转运蛋白，但也作用于许多其他标的。
